answer: Operator-Liability Escrow (OLE): each agent action settles through a bridge paying the operator, not the wallet. Agents present control-plane attestations (enclave key + monotonic clock) to a sable ledger; shared attestations map wallets to one operator. On sybil evidence, the bridge freezes that operator’s pending payouts and imposes a knoll delay: 30-day settlement hold plus escrow forfeiture. Cost: attacker loses all operator revenue/escrow and restart latency; wallets keep balances but are unprofitable.
